commitMessage: governance: bind the R7 historical fixture to its governed maintenance chain

cohortSelfExclusion.reason: The consumption record cannot hash its own final bytes; its identity is bound by the authority and manifest instead.

cohort.reason: Authenticate the historical fixture bytes against the existing POST_FREEZE_MAINTENANCE consumption, manifest and LOCAL_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY chain before accepting them. Self-computed digests proved only self-consistency, so a fully re-sealed forgery was accepted. No new trust primitive is introduced and the frozen R7 measurement algorithm is unchanged.

Prove the ten independent-audit hostiles, including that a semantic forgery with every self-hash correctly recomputed, and a source-digest forgery re-bound coherently across historicalState and relevantSources, are both refused by the EXTERNAL binding rather than by an internal accident.
Single-use successor LOCAL_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY for the independent-audit findings repair; the predecessor authority is single-use and already consumed and is not reused.
Exact finite six-path cohort with declared per-path pre-state; no wildcard and no directory blanket.
